name: Uttar Pradesh Association of Apartment Owners (UP Apartment Act 2010 + Model Bye-laws 2011)

instruments.value: Uttar Pradesh Apartment (Promotion of Construction, Ownership and Maintenance) Act, 2010 (UP Act 16 of 2010)
instruments.note: s.14 = Association of Apartment Owners and bye-laws. Act text itself not read directly; amended by UP Act 30 of 2016 (s.14(2),(5)); one search result says the 2016 amendment was not notified in force (Lotus Boulevard case) - not verified.
instruments.source: UP Act 16 of 2010 s.14 (secondary summary: https://indiankanoon.org/doc/91371337/ ; India Code PDF https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/16832/1/english16of2010.pdf not retrievable: HTTP 403)

instruments.note: Primary text read in full. Association adopts bye-laws at first meeting based on model; departure only with prior approval of competent authority (s.14(6), secondary).
instruments.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law all

instruments.note: UP Apartment (Promotion of Construction, Ownership and Maintenance) Rules, 2011: reported by secondary results (notification 16 Nov 2011, under s.30) but text could not be fetched. Rules provisions on meetings/elections not verified.

instruments.value: Societies Registration Act 1860 (as applied in UP) for registration of AOA
instruments.note: Allahabad HC Windsor Park (11 Mar 2019): AOA must be registered before Registrar under Societies Act though not a society in the strict sense; s.25(2) Registrar can call election meeting.

calledBy.value: Association; date decided by association; AGM in first quarter of each financial year; Board specifies manner
calledBy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 13, 25(g), 26(i)

noticeDays.note: Secretary mails/sends notice 'at least two days but not more than seven days' before; copy to competent authority or registrar
noticeDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 15

noticeContent.value: Purpose, time and place; notices also sent to competent authority or registrar
noticeContent.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 15

chair.value: President presides over all meetings of Association and Board; Vice-President in absence
chair.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 19, 20

calledBy.value: President must call: on Board resolution, or petition signed by a majority of owners presented to Secretary, or request of Competent Authority (or authorised officer)
calledBy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 14

noticeDays.note: Same notice rule as annual meetings
noticeDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 15

noticeContent.value: Time, place and purpose; no other business without consent of two-thirds of owners present in person
noticeContent.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 14

chair.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 19

calledBy.value: Time and place determined by majority of office bearers; at least two per year
calledBy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 30

noticeDays.note: Notice personally or by mail at least three days prior
noticeDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 30

quorum.value: One-third of total strength of office bearers; if less, majority present may adjourn and not less than 3 present form quorum
quorum.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 33

calledBy.value: President on 3 days notice; President or Secretary must call on written request of at least three office bearers
calledBy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 31

noticeDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 31

quorum.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 33

meetingTypes.type: first meeting of newly elected Board

calledBy.value: Held within ten days of election; no notice needed if majority of Board present
calledBy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 29

noticeDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 29

quorum.note: 'presence in person of 30 percent of owners' (counted by owners, not votes)
quorum.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 9

adjournedQuorum.note: Adjourn to not less than 48 hours later; if still no quorum, owners present in person, not less than two, form quorum
adjournedQuorum.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 16

ordinary.value: Majority of owners casting votes in person or proxy; 'majority' of owners defined as owners holding 51 per cent of the votes (ambiguity between bye-law 2(e) and 10)
ordinary.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 2(e), 10

special.value: Two-thirds of owners present in person to allow un-noticed business at special meeting (bye-law 14); owners representing at least two-thirds of total units plus prior competent-authority approval to amend bye-laws (bye-law 58)
special.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 14, 58

removalOfOfficeBearers.value: Majority of apartment owners at regular or special meeting duly called; office bearer to be heard
removalOfOfficeBearers.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 28

boardElection.value: Board of 4-10 'elected by the members by simple majority in the General Body Meeting'
boardElection.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 18

weightageModels.note: Voting on percentage basis: percentage assigned to the dwelling unit(s) in the Declaration (bye-law 8). Joint owners: only the first-named person votes (5). Each owner must hold at least one share (6). Not one-flat-one-vote by default.
weightageModels.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 8, 5, 6

proxy.note: Bye-law 10 says votes 'will be cast in person' but resolutions need majority of owners casting votes 'in person or proxy'; chapter titled 'Voting, Quorum and Proxies' but no proxy form or limit; quorum requires owners present in person.
proxy.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 10

votingMethods.note: Annual meeting elects Board 'by ballot of the apartment owners'
votingMethods.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 13

electronicVoting.note: No provision for e-meeting, e-voting or video conferencing in the model bye-laws (read in full) or in any UP source found; the Act and Rules 2011 not read in full. Bye-law 12 only says meetings at a suitable place convenient to owners.
electronicVoting.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 12; searches found no UP rule

minutesDeadlineDays.note: No deadline. Secretary keeps two minute books (Association; Board), pages consecutively numbered and authenticated by President (bye-law 21); minutes of preceding meeting read at next meeting (bye-law 17(c)).
minutesDeadlineDays.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-laws 17, 21

recordRetentionYears.note: No retention period in model bye-laws. Related: audited financial statement published by 31 July, copy to competent authority by 15 Aug, summary to each owner within 15 days (49(3)-(6)); statement and auditor report kept in conspicuous place (50).
recordRetentionYears.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-laws 49, 50

value.auditedFinancialStatement: open to inspection by any member during office hours

memberInspectionRight.note: Explicit only for audited statement (and list of owners/loanees accompanying it)
memberInspectionRight.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 49(4), 49(5)

value.fallback: Registrar may call and preside over a general body meeting to elect office-bearers if election not held in time or set aside (Societies Act as applied in UP, s.25(2)); prescribed authority decides election disputes (s.25(1)); appeal to Divisional Commissioner within one month (UP Act 8/2022)

electionRoles.note: Model bye-laws provide no returning officer, nomination, scrutiny, withdrawal or tie-break. President, VP, Secretary, Treasurer elected by and from the Board (bye-law 18), though 26(i) says AGM elects 4-10 members 'including' those four; Windsor Park read 18 and 26 together.
electionRoles.source: Model Bye-laws 18, 26; Societies Registration Act 1860 as applied in UP (UP Acts 52/1975, 11/1984, 23/2013, 8/2022): https://indiankanoon.org/doc/343062/ ; https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/uttar-pradesh/1975/1975UP52.pdf; https://indiankanoon.org/doc/92753425/

value.rotation: one third of Board retire annually (26(ii)); continue until successors elected and held first meeting (26(iii))

termYears.note: Allahabad HC (Windsor Park, secondary summary) treated the Board as a continuing body with annual one-third retirement, rejecting a one-year-Board-term view; office bearers one-year unless re-elected
termYears.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 26

eligibility.value: Apartment owner/Member of Association; not eligible if found guilty of misusing the post in previous term (26(i) proviso); arrears disqualifier (7)
eligibility.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 2(c), 26, 7

value.measuredAt: last day of the year preceding the election year
value.effect: cannot vote in or stand for election of Board or any office bearer

defaulterDisqualification.note: Arrears of contributions for common expenses for more than sixty days
defaulterDisqualification.source: UP Apartment Model Bye-laws, Notification 3977/8-1-11-115D.A./02T.C.-1 dated 16 Nov 2011 (made under s.14(6) UP Act 16 of 2010), https://up-rera.in/pdf/Model-By-Laws.pdf, bye-law 7

notes: Applicability: buildings covered by the 2010 Act; competent authority = authority notified by govt (usually development authority) - secondary.
UP Ownership of Flats Act 1975 relevance NOT verified; repeal/overlap with the 2010 Act not checked.
UP RERA (UP Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act/Rules 2016) interaction with association formation not verified; model bye-laws PDF is hosted on up-rera.in.
Retrieved 2026-10-23. Research only; not legal advice.

name: RWA registered under Societies Registration Act 1860 (UP variant)

instruments.value: Societies Registration Act, 1860 (Act 21 of 1860) as applied in Uttar Pradesh
instruments.note: Central Act mostly leaves meetings, quorum and voting to society rules; read only via secondary reproductions.

instruments.value: UP amendments: Act 25/1958; 52/1975 (ss.3, 4(2), 4A, 12A-12D, 25); 11/1984 (s.4 proviso); 23/2013 (s.4B); 8/2022 (appeals, s.4B approval, s.5A, s.16A, s.25 appeal)
instruments.note: Gazette PDF and indiankanoon text read for these provisions.
instruments.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 as applied in UP (UP Acts 52/1975, 11/1984, 23/2013, 8/2022): https://indiankanoon.org/doc/343062/ ; https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/uttar-pradesh/1975/1975UP52.pdf

instruments.note: No official UP model RWA bye-laws found; Delhi or other RWA model bye-laws not read.

calledBy.note: Not fixed by Act; s.4 assumes an AGM held 'according to the rules of the society'.
calledBy.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

noticeDays.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

noticeContent.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

calledBy.value: Per society rules; UP s.12A: name change by resolution at a general meeting convened for the purpose; s.12 contemplates special meetings for altering purposes
calledBy.note: UP s.12A (Act 52/1975) requires consent of not less than two-thirds of total members; s.12 details from secondary text only
calledBy.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 as applied in UP (UP Acts 52/1975, 11/1984, 23/2013, 8/2022): https://indiankanoon.org/doc/343062/ ; https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/uttar-pradesh/1975/1975UP52.pdf

noticeDays.note: Only for s.12 purpose-alteration proposals, per secondary reproductions; not a general rule

noticeContent.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

calledBy.value: Registrar (or authorised officer) convenes and presides over general body meeting to elect office-bearers if election not held within time in society rules or an election is set aside; no other authority may call another election meeting meanwhile

noticeDays.note: Society's own rules on meetings and elections apply with necessary modifications
noticeDays.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

noticeContent.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

quorum.note: No statutory quorum found; society rules.
quorum.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

adjournedQuorum.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

ordinary.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

special.note: Verified from primary only for UP s.12A; s.12/13 from secondary summaries
special.source: UP s.12A: https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/uttar-pradesh/1975/1975UP52.pdf; s.12/13: search snippets of industries.delhi.gov.in/industries/registration-act

weightageModels.note: Not set by Act; one-member-one-vote is typical but not verified.
weightageModels.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

proxy.note: Secondary text of central s.12/13 mentions votes 'in person or by proxy' for those resolutions, implying proxies are contemplated; no general rule found; society rules decide.

votingMethods.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

electronicVoting.note: No UP Registrar order or UP/central provision on online or hybrid general body meetings or e-voting for societies found (searched 2026-10-23). Do not assume allowed; check society bye-laws.

minutesDeadlineDays.note: Not in Act. UP s.4B(1) lets Registrar verify members list against register of members, minutes book, cash book, receipt book and bank passbook, so those records must exist.
minutesDeadlineDays.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

recordRetentionYears.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

memberInspectionRight.note: Public may inspect documents filed with Registrar under s.19 (fee-based; secondary). Member inspection of society's own records is not in the Act; society rules.

value.fallback: Registrar may call/preside election meeting (s.25(2)); prescribed authority decides election disputes on reference by Registrar or at least one-fourth of members (s.25(1)); appeal to Divisional Commissioner within one month (UP Act 8/2022)

electionRoles.note: Election mechanics are set by society rules; statute supplies only dispute/default machinery

termYears.note: Society rules. s.4 requires annual list within 14 days after AGM (or in January if no AGM); UP proviso (Act 11/1984): countersignature of old members or Registrar notice/objections.
termYears.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

eligibility.value: Disqualified: undischarged insolvent; convicted of offence in connection with management of a society/body corporate; offence of moral turpitude; any criminal offence with punishment of 2 years or more - from date of judgment
eligibility.note: UP s.16-A as substituted by UP Act 8/2022 (2022 Act pages inside https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/uttar-pradesh/1975/1975UP52.pdf)

defaulterDisqualification.note: Not in Act; RWA bye-laws may bar arrears defaulters.
defaulterDisqualification.source: Societies Registration Act 1860 (central) - no such provision found in secondary reproductions; left to society rules/bye-laws (s.2-3). India Code PDF not retrievable.

notes: Registration filings: annual list of managing body (s.4); changes in rules and address within 30 days certified by 3 governing-body members (s.4A); members list at registration/renewal and modified list within one month signed by 2 office bearers and 2 executive members, change valid only if approved by Managing Body (s.4B as amended 2013 and 2022); appeals to Divisional Commissioner (UP Act 8/2022).
UP s.5A (2022): transfer of society immovable property needs prior court approval.
Most meeting rules for an RWA come from its own bye-laws; this pack cannot supply defaults. Retrieved 2026-10-23. Research only; not legal advice.
